explication: Kumo is a lightweight AWS-compatible service emulator. An AWS SDK client sends requests to the single local server; routing and protocol decoders identify the target service, whose handlers execute API operations against in-memory service stores. Stores optionally persist state, while selected integrations model streams and message delivery. The repository advertises 82 emulated services, so representative storage, compute, networking, identity, messaging, workflow, and management branches are shown; unsampled service implementations are grouped rather than inferred individually.
